title: Paseo: Control Your Dev Workflow from Your Phone
description:
You kicked off a massive refactor, stepped away from your desk, and now you're flying blind. Paseo runs a lightweight daemon on your machine and connects your phone via end-to-end encrypted relay. Dictate feature requests with push-to-talk, watch live terminal output stream to your phone in real time. Review diffs,  approve terminal commands remotely. Zero forced accounts, zero cloud telemetry.

https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo

#github #opensource
